seeds.name: stale version string
seeds.description: Replaces a version literal with the stale string 9.9.9

seeds.name: dropped return value
seeds.description: Drops the value from a return so the caller gets nothing

seeds.name: inverted comparison
seeds.description: Flips a comparison operator to its opposite

seeds.name: off by one constant
seeds.description: Adds one to an integer constant in a return or comparison

seeds.name: swallowed exception
seeds.description: Replaces an exception handler body with a silent pass

seeds.name: inverted boolean literal
seeds.description: Flips a boolean literal to its opposite

seeds.name: swapped arithmetic operator
seeds.description: Swaps an arithmetic operator for a different one

seeds.name: dropped call argument
seeds.description: Drops the last argument from a call that takes at least two

seeds.name: negated condition
seeds.description: Wraps an if condition in a negation

seeds.name: removed collection element
seeds.description: Removes the first element from a list or dictionary literal

seeds.name: range bound shifted by one
seeds.description: Raises the last bound of a range call by one

seeds.name: wrong variable returned
seeds.description: Returns the next parameter instead of the one the code named

seeds.name: swapped operand order
seeds.description: Swaps the operands of a subtraction, division, floor division, or modulo, where the order of the operands decides the result

seeds.name: dropped else branch
seeds.description: Drops the else branch of a conditional so the fallback path never runs

seeds.name: swapped boolean operator
seeds.description: Swaps a boolean and for an or, or an or for an and, in a compound condition

seeds.name: dropped await
seeds.description: Removes an await so the caller holds a coroutine instead of the awaited result

seeds.name: widened exception handler
seeds.description: Widens an exception handler so it catches the broad base error type

seeds.name: swapped dictionary entry
seeds.description: Swaps the key and the value of a dictionary entry so the mapping answers backwards

seeds.name: inverted truth test
seeds.description: Toggles the negation on a condition test so its sense reads backwards on the shapes no other seed plants

seeds.name: reassigned loop variable
seeds.description: Points a for loop at a different name already bound in the same scope so the loop writes into the wrong variable

seeds.name: swapped call argument order
seeds.description: Swaps the first two positional arguments of a call so each value reaches the wrong parameter

seeds.name: altered string literal
seeds.description: Changes the first character of a string literal so the text the code compares or returns is no longer the text it wrote

seeds.name: dropped numeric negation
seeds.description: Removes a unary minus so a value carries the opposite sign from the one the code wrote

seeds.name: swapped loop control
seeds.description: Turns a break inside a loop into a continue so the loop runs on instead of ending
